entities.name: Filip Šovagović
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Filip Šovagović is a Croatian actor, film director, comedian, playwright and journalist. At first known simply as the son of renowned actor Fabijan Šovagović, he has established himself as one of the most prolific Croatian actors of the 21st century.
